design: Quarantine one unchanged official package, inspect its file inventory and licensing before extracting selected authored rigged hand/glove geometry and textures. Do not execute included scripts, install Unity, use credentials, pay, contact the author, or integrate into runtime. No modification/rendering of artwork until source reuse permission is verified.
gates: ordinary official free download, no bypass of login, paywall or technical restriction
record SHA256 and archive inventory without exposing signed download URLs or tokens
verify explicit license permits this Three.js/browser game use; unknown or Unity-only terms block use
safe extraction rejects absolute paths, traversal, links and duplicate logical paths
inspect source rig, skinning, authored textures and animations before any retargeting
later assembly requires actual viewmodel poses, material/geometry budgets and headless browser review
